text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing the modern workplace. One of its biggest impacts is automation, where AI handles repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling. This frees up employees to focus on more creative and complex work. Additionally, productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart email filters and virtual assistants, help people work faster and manage their time better. Importantly, AI is not simply replacing humans; it is enabling human-AI collaboration. For example, doctors use AI to analyze scans, while making the final diagnosis themselves. This shift means some jobs will change or disappear, but many new roles will emerge, requiring workers to learn new skills and adapt to a future where technology and human insight work together.
